# platforms/Sm90 directory

Hopper (sm_90a) instrs and memory types: TMA (`Sm90_tma*.py`, `Sm90_tensorMap.py`), swizzled SMEM (`Sm90_smem.py`), ThunderKittens-based wgmma (`Sm90_tk_mma*.py`), and the gemm generator `tk_gemm_util.py` (the only code that substitutes wgmma via `replace`; see `schedule_gemm`).

* `Sm90_tk_mma.py` and `Sm90_tma.py` are generated by `gen_Sm90_tk_mma.py` / `gen_Sm90_tma.py`.
  (`gen_Sm90_tk_mma.py` was stale from `e6743eff` until fixed in `b22b1a53`; it now reproduces its output verbatim.)
* wgmma instrs come in two families per A/B mode ([plan_wgmma_zero.md](../../../../plan_wgmma_zero.md)): accumulate-only `Sm90_tk_mma_{a}_{b}` (scale-d hardwired to 1) and zero-init `Sm90_tk_mma_{a}_{b}_zi` (runtime `zero_init: bool` last arg; `scale-d = !zero_init` on native k-step 0).
  `Sm90_tk_zero_scale_d`, `exo_CudaTkScaleD`, and `wgmma_zero_qual` are gone; `CudaTkWarpTile` allocates plain `::kittens::rt_*`.
* `tk_gemm_util.remove_tail_guards_keep_zero`: `schedule_gemm`'s replacement for recursive `unsafe_remove_if` on the wgmma `ms` loop; removes every `If` except the `if iter_k == 0: D_rmem = 0` zero-init guard (identified structurally).
